Subject: AtlasHealth inference pilot — demo availability and MAP

Hi Sana —

Following up from our call last week: the team asked for a short 45-minute demo focused on inference economics and rollout patterns (dedicated vs hosted) so we can align on scope for the pilot. Suggested times that worked for me this week:
- Tue 10/27, 10:30–11:15 PT
- Wed 10/28, 14:00–14:45 PT

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan and a short Redwood one-pager to give your PMs a quick sense of what we typically deliver in a 6–8 week pilot.

If those slots don't work, tell me a window that works for your team and I can propose alternatives. Marcus (cc'd) will join to walk through deployment options.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Thanks Grace — I really appreciate you following up. I wanted to give you a quick update from our side: we just had a roadmap re-prioritization this week and the platform team has paused new ML/LLM pilots while we finish an internal migration (moving several services to the new infra stack). That shift is driven by executive-level resourcing decisions and a travel-heavy quarter for our PMs.

Because of that, we're going to deprioritize the inference pilot for now. Can we pause scheduling the demo? I expect we should be able to revisit in early January 2027 once the migration is complete.

Apologies for the churn — it's not a reflection on Redwood's platform, just a temporary shift for AtlasHealth. Could you keep a note on your side and check back in the first week of January?

Best,
Sana Ahmed
Director, Platform Engineering
Sana.Ahmed@atlashealth.com
